title: Duplicate Charge on Hotel Booking
description: Customer was charged twice for the identical amount ($248.50) by the same hotel merchant on consecutive days.

customer_profile.name: Jessica Pearson
customer_profile.context_summary: Two pending/posted charges of $248.50 with identical merchant authorization ID.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting Apex Bank Credit Card Services. My name is Alex. How may I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I checked my recent transactions and I was charged twice for the exact same hotel booking of two hundred and forty-eight dollars and fifty cents.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see both entries on your ledger for two hundred and forty-eight dollars and fifty cents. Let me initiate a duplicate charge dispute for you right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Will I get a provisional credit while your team investigates the merchant?

expected_summary.call_overview: Customer called regarding an identical duplicate charge of $248.50 from a hotel merchant.
required_followups: Merchant dispute resolution within 30-45 calendar days
